fusions.name: Parting Sting
fusions.desc: Butts the target for 8 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Angry Hive
fusions.desc: Kicks over a hive, dealing 26 poison damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Bellwether's Hum
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage and has 1 more Power for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Tireless Grazing
fusions.desc: Each stretch of ground you cover restores 6 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
